title: SEC6: FailingClient enables deterministic failure injection
description: FailingClient is a zero-field struct that implements DeliverClient and always returns PeerDeliveryError::Network. Testing outbox retry without it would require either a real unreachable host (racy, slow) or OS-level socket manipulation (complex, platform-specific). Because outbox_tick is generic over DeliverClient, substituting FailingClient requires no changes to production code and no conditional compilation in the worker itself. The struct has no state, so there is nothing to set up or tear down.
